features.name: Grit and Deeds
features.summary: Gain grit equal to Wisdom modifier and spend it on 1st-level deeds: deadeye, gunslinger's dodge, and quick clear.

features.name: Gunsmith
features.summary: Gain a battered firearm and Gunsmithing as a bonus feat.

features.name: 3rd-level Deeds
features.summary: Gain gunslinger initiative, pistol-whip, utility shot, and dead shot.

features.name: Nimble
features.summary: Gain +1 dodge bonus to AC while wearing light or no armour; increases every 4 levels.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: Choose a combat or grit feat.

features.name: Gun Training
features.summary: Choose one firearm type; add Dexterity to damage and reduce misfire by 1.

features.name: 7th-level Deeds
features.summary: Gain startling shot, targeting, and expert loading.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: Choose another combat or grit feat.

features.name: 11th-level Deeds
features.summary: Gain bleeding wound, lightning reload, and signature deed.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: Choose another combat or grit feat.

features.name: 15th-level Deeds
features.summary: Gain evasive, menacing shot, and sling free.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: Choose another combat or grit feat.

features.name: 19th-level Deeds
features.summary: Gain cheat death, death's shot, and stunning shot.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: Choose another combat or grit feat.

features.name: True Grit
features.summary: Choose two deeds and reduce their grit cost by 1, to a minimum of 0.
